fields.label: Slab
fields.description: Which slab of the scheme the cart landed in. Recorded because when a rep and a manager disagree about an offer, the disagreement is nearly always about which slab was reached, not about the arithmetic inside it.

fields.label: Benefit
fields.options:
Free Goods
Percent Discount
Value Discount
Rate Off
Incentive

fields.label: Reads As
fields.description: The offer in one plain sentence, written by the server for the rep to say out loud. A rep standing at a counter cannot read a slab table to a shopkeeper who is already reaching for the next customer.

fields.label: Qualifying Value
fields.description: The gross value of the lines this scheme actually qualified on, which is the base a percentage was taken off. Stored because a 5% soap scheme must never be seen to have discounted the tea.

fields.label: Benefit
fields.description: What this benefit is worth in rupees. On an Incentive row this is money for the rep and is reported separately - it never comes off the shop's bill, and adding it in would overstate the discount the shopkeeper was given.

fields.label: Free Qty
fields.description: Base units granted free by this benefit. The goods themselves are listed in the free-goods table; this is the tally the ledger settles against.

fields.label: Budget Warning
fields.description: The scheme applied but its budget is spent. Set only where the scheme is configured to warn rather than block, since a half-funded scheme is a number nobody can reconcile.

fields.label: Ledger Entry
fields.description: The accrual this benefit produced. Without it, a claim at month end has no line-level evidence to stand on.
